levels.description:
Little Engineer Form: Grants the special high ground device in front <@ba.vup>1</> SP per second. This effect is doubled during Nasti's skill duration.
High Ground Form: Upgrades when SP is full (up to 3 times). After the first upgrade, can block 1 enemy and an Operator can be deployed on it. Each upgrade provides the deployed Operator with a stack of a buff that increases Max HP and ATK by <@ba.vup>+{attack@nasti_nstbld[m4_bonus].atk:0%}</>. After upgrading 3 times, the device remains on the field even when Nasti retreats
